guards: Every context comes from RegisteredEvent plus Interpretation of that exact record, never a free Scope.
Resolve exactly one actor/target and at most one instrument; unresolved/plural roles stay unsupported candidates.
Human anchor needs an explicit Universe.IsHuman proof; Entity labels or actor identity do not provide it.
Use explicit injective maps for graph/registry-scoped entity/event/interpretation/episode/action identities, not lossy string-to-number coercion.
Normalize time under an explicit clock policy before constructing Nat times; preserve clockKey as unverified external metadata.
Reject duplicate GroundAssessment for the same owner/condition, or provide an explicit reviewed aggregation contract. Never select only the favorable sign.
Include all accepted positive/negative supports under explicit mapping decisions; pending/rejected supports are not silently promoted or discarded as facts.
Require start <= finish and every requested literal present with its opposite absent.
Tree.verify must validate the fixed certificate with the exact profileRule for this mode/context in the authorized catalog.
The negative selected effect must be absent; a valid Tree alone does not establish profile admission.
responseBoundary: relationActive/breachRecorded are profile markers; neither proves generic relation applicability, response authority, liability or sanction.
unmappedMetadata: Independent relationDutyBearer, DutySpecification identity and applicability semantics are not separate R3 Scope arguments.
Counterpart and ResponseRule identities are not represented by the R3 profile.
Deadline.dueAt does not compute deadlineElapsed; elapsed is an explicit supplied ground.
clockKey and source-citation identifiers are not Lean literal arguments.
If claiming a generic duty result, explicitly review any duty-bearer/human-anchor alignment and applicability outside R3; never infer equality from actor.
Source quote relevance, factual truth and snapshot origin remain unverified.
ActionRequirement.actionRequirementKind is not compared with the context action by R3; a generic duty claim needs an explicit matching decision outside the profile.
StateRequirement has no direct R3 state-condition slot; operationalizing it as an action needs a separate reviewed mapping and is not proved by performed alone.
